title: Doctor_Doom Totem
description: A Doctor Doom–inspired Totem of Undying with clean Minecraft-style details.
body: I made a Doctor Doom–themed Totem of Undying for Minecraft, inspired by the iconic Marvel villain. This custom totem features Doom’s signature mask and armor colors, detailed in a clean Minecraft style while keeping the vanilla feel. Perfect for Marvel fans who want a dark, powerful-looking totem without changing core gameplay.
